written.question: A training institute is setting up a network where the main backbone uses a bus topology, connecting one star topology and two ring topologies. Construct the hybrid network diagram.

items.label: Bus backbone drawn as one line (with terminators/taps)
Star: hub with stations each linked only to the hub
Two rings, each a closed loop of stations attached to the bus
All parts labelled (backbone, hub, ring 1, ring 2)

rubric.modelAnswer: Draw a bus backbone with three drop lines: one to a hub with four stations (star), and one each to two rings of four stations. A hybrid topology combines two or more topologies; here the bus is the backbone.
